_comment: TRANSCRIBED from the pages named above on the date named above.
A fab changes its capabilities without changing this file, so treat
every number as a starting point and confirm it against the vendor
before a board is ordered. Fields the vendor does not publish are
null and listed in not_published; they are NOT zero and NOT unlimited.
Values are millimetres exactly as published, so each one can be
checked against the source by eye. Conversion to the mils that
FabProfile uses happens on load, in one place.

capability_notes.min_track_mm: 0.09 mm on multilayer; 0.10 mm on 1 and 2 layer boards. The tighter figure is used here, so a 2-layer design wants the looser one checked.
capability_notes.min_gap_mm: 0.09 mm on multilayer; 0.10 mm on 1 and 2 layer. 3 mil is accepted inside BGA fan-outs only.
capability_notes.min_drill_mm: 0.15 mm for 2-layer and multilayer. 0.10 mm exists for boards 1 mm thick or less with ENIG or OSP, at extra cost. Minimum non-plated hole is 0.50 mm.
capability_notes.min_annular_ring_mm: 0.15 mm absolute on multilayer at 1 oz, 0.20 mm recommended. 2-layer is 0.18 mm absolute, 0.25 mm recommended. 2 oz copper is 0.254 mm.
capability_notes.min_silk_width_mm: 0.15 mm line width; minimum text height 1.0 mm; pad-to-silkscreen clearance 0.15 mm.

not_published.min_hole_to_hole_mm: Not stated for rigid boards on the capabilities page. A castellated figure appears on the FLEX page and does not transfer.
not_published.min_mask_sliver_mm: Not stated. The page gives a solder mask BRIDGE figure (0.10 mm pad spacing at 1 oz for most colours, 0.13 mm for black and white, 0.20 mm at 2 oz), which is a different measurement and is not reused here.

stackups.name: JLC04161H-7628
stackups.source_note: JLCPCB's default 4-layer impedance template for a 1.6 mm board. The CORE thickness changes with the ordered board thickness, so this stackup is specific to 1.6 mm.

more_stackups.note: JLCPCB publishes many more impedance templates (7628A, 7628B, 2116 and so on, across 4 to 32 layers) than are transcribed here. Only the default 4-layer one is carried, because each transcription is a number somebody has to check.
more_stackups.bulk_source_note: A third-party script that pulls JLCPCB's impedance-template API and emits Altium .stackupx and KiCad files, 562 of them. Its generated files and normalised JSON are public domain, the script is MIT, and its own README warns the output is automated and unverified.
